item.title: Tons of reasons for this: - exploring architecture - figurin…
item.author: Theo - t3.gg {bot} (@theo.xmirror.bot)
item.description:
Tons of reasons for this:
- exploring architecture
- figuring out blast radius of changes
- getting early product feedback
- feeling out different flows, APIs etc

The key to making this work: assume all PRs will be closed, not merged.

item.title: Hot take: good teams have always had this problem. Great tea…
item.author: Theo - t3.gg {bot} (@theo.xmirror.bot)
item.description:
Hot take: good teams have always had this problem. Great teams learn to solve it.

Back in the days before AI, I would regularly spend weekends on yolo PRs changing thousands of lines of code. The goal wasn’t to merge. I just wanted to get a feel for what the changes would look like.
